gloss: person who encounters; witness (to an event)

definitions.gloss: person who encounters (something); witness to an event
definitions.explanation: A person who has come across or experienced a particular event, incident, or phenomenon. Often used in contexts of accidents, disasters, unusual experiences, or encounters with wildlife.

examples.japanese: {熊|くま}の{遭遇者|そうぐうしゃ}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The number of people encountering bears is increasing.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}の{遭遇者|そうぐうしゃ}から{証言|しょうげん}を{集|あつ}めた。
examples.english: Testimony was gathered from witnesses to the accident.

examples.japanese: UFOの{遭遇者|そうぐうしゃ}が{体験|たいけん}を{語|かた}るドキュメンタリーが{放送|ほうそう}された。
examples.english: A documentary was broadcast in which UFO witnesses describe their experiences.

notes:
Composed of {遭遇|そうぐう} (encounter/meeting) and {者|しゃ} (person). The word {遭遇|そうぐう} typically implies an unexpected or chance encounter, so {遭遇者|そうぐうしゃ} often describes someone who has unexpectedly come across something noteworthy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遭遇者|そうぐうしゃ}の{証言|しょうげん}: testimony from witnesses
- {遭遇者|そうぐうしゃ}の{体験談|たいけんだん}: firsthand account of an encounter
- {遭遇者|そうぐうしゃ}が{語|かた}る: a witness recounts

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {目撃者|もくげきしゃ}: eyewitness — specifically someone who saw something happen
- {被害者|ひがいしゃ}: victim — someone who suffered harm
- {当事者|とうじしゃ}: person involved — a party in an event or dispute
- {遭遇|そうぐう}: encounter — the base verb-noun
